Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: Fixed: role actions (Arm's Length, Lucid Dreaming...) now show only once that class or job has learned them by its own level. Fixed: with the mouse over one of our frames, ground actions like Asylum now land on that unit instead of under the frame. Fixed: closed triggers in the tracker editor stay closed when you move another one. Fixed: a "missing" tracker no longer shows for a status the target cannot have (a debuff on an ally, a buff on an enemy). New: White Mage auras for Freecure and Sacred Sight; the Freecure fades from right to left as the time runs out. New: triggers can now be limited to the last seconds of a status (Max seconds left) and have a Washed out effect, so a DoT looks calm while it lasts and stands out when it is time to refresh it. Clean installs now come with this for Dia, Aero, Biolysis, Combust, Eukrasian Dosis, Thunder, Stormbite, Caustic Bite, Higanbana, Death's Design and the Dragoon DoT; existing setups keep what they have (use Import all presets again to get it).
